audience: sales and service teams that keep their customer data in Lime CRM

useCases.title: Find objects of one type
useCases.text: List the limetypes to learn the names. Query the objects of one type with a filter and the fields you need.

useCases.title: Look up an object and its definition
useCases.text: Read one object by its type and id. Read the type definition to see the property names.

useCases.title: Review the users of the application
useCases.text: List the active users or the users of one type. The API user needs admin rights for this.

useCases.title: Create a new object
useCases.text: Create one object of a type with the field values you give. The server cannot delete or undo it.
